map.精确率与召回率是做什么的？: What does Precision and Recall do?
map.如何使用精确率与召回率？: How do I use Precision and Recall?
map.精确率与召回率适合哪些场景？: What scenarios is Precision and Recall best for?
map.计算二分类的精确率、召回率与 F1。: Compute precision, recall and F1 for binary classification.
map.精确率 P = TP/(TP+FP)；召回率 R = TP/(TP+FN)；F1: Precision P = TP/(TP+FP); Recall R = TP/(TP+FN); F1 = 2PR/(P+R)
map.P 与 R 天然此消彼长：放宽阈值召回升高但误报增多。F1 用调和平均综合两者，: P and R naturally trade off: lowering the threshold raises recall but increases false alarms. F1 uses the harmonic mean to combine them, more sensitive to the smaller one (near 0 when F1 is near 0), suiting a single trade-off metric; if the business cares more about missed detections (e.g. disease screening), switch to F2 which weights recall.
map.精确率关注预测正确性，召回率关注覆盖度。: Precision focuses on prediction correctness, recall on coverage.
map.精确率 P=TP/(TP+FP) 衡量预测为正的纯度；召回 R=TP/(TP+F: Precision P=TP/(TP+FP) measures the purity of positive predictions; recall R=TP/(TP+FN) measures positive-class coverage.
map.F1=2PR/(P+R) 调和平均，二者冲突时综合评估。: F1=2PR/(P+R) harmonic mean, a combined assessment when the two conflict.
map.阈值升高→精确率升、召回降；按业务代价选平衡点(如反欺诈重召回)。: Higher threshold -> precision up, recall down; choose the balance by business cost (e.g. anti-fraud favors recall).
map.某模型 TP=80,FP=20,FN=10。阈值低时 FP 多 P=80/100: A model with TP=80,FP=20,FN=10. At a low threshold FP is large: P=80/100=80%, R=80/90=89%; raising the threshold drops FP to 5 but FN rises to 30 -> P=80/85=94%, R=80/110=73%.
map.漏检代价高时(癌症筛查、欺诈拦截)，宁肯多报假阳性也要少漏，优先高召回；再用人工: When missed-detection cost is high (cancer screening, fraud interception), prefer false positives over misses and prioritize high recall; then filter false positives with humans or a second model.
map.PR 曲线和 ROC 曲线怎么选？: How to choose between the PR curve and the ROC curve?
map.类别不平衡时 PR 曲线更敏感、更贴切；ROC 在平衡数据下更稳。AUC-PR: Under class imbalance the PR curve is more sensitive and fitting; ROC is more stable on balanced data. AUC-PR better reflects performance when positives are rare.
